text:
Good morning,

I hope this email finds you well - I was just having a cup of coffee and thinking about the upcoming summer, which got me to my daughter's wedding planning. We've been looking around for the perfect venue and I immediately thought of the Ashdown when I saw it online. We're planning to have it on the 14th August 2027, and I was wondering if we could have it from 2pm until 17:30. We'll be collecting the Ashdown from your garage, so that should all be sorted on our end. I've attached my driving licence for your records.

Kind regards,
Ada Yarrowfield 
+70 808 302 8025
